capabilities: Counts every checkbox in the current note
Renders a labeled progress bar from a progress-bar code block
Configures which characters count as checked or unchecked
Ignores checkboxes whose character is in neither list
Updates the bar live as the note is edited
extras: The author's own setup treats extra states (e.g. a "forwarded" checkbox) as complete via a CSS snippet; characters in neither list are ignored and not counted.
problem: Obsidian shows no at-a-glance completion indicator for all checkboxes in a note.
summary: Renders a whole-note checkbox progress bar in a progress-bar code block, with configurable checked and unchecked characters.
